description:
## v5.50.2-ample.2
### KakaoTalk
- Update compatibility for kakaotalk to version 26.2.0
- Reimplement the patch to disable Talk Share Log and fix the incorrect behavior
- The Moat integrity check bypass patch has been reimplemented to enable more stable use of KakaoPay. This patch is disabled by default.

### ETC
- The upstream corresponding to revanced-patches v5.50.2 has been merged.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AmpleReVanced/revanced-patches/compare/v5.48.0-ample.4...v5.50.2-ample.2
